proposition.claim:
The printed C_b=Res(W'_nb) Ind(H_nb/2 to W_nb) eta produces an extra copy in the claimed multiplicity-to-painting equality.

Unit top-wedge norm and reversal-Gram compatible basis are incompatible in odd orthogonal rank.

Ind_{S_t}^{W'_t} tau_L is ill-typed when tau_L=tau_R has size t/2; p59 (O'_b,O'_b) has total size2nb rather than nb.
